source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 3 ("Newtownards nominations: Victoria Ward")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Election of aldermen and councillors for Newtownards Borough Council on 18 September 1946. Castle, Scrabo and Glen councillorships were contested; Victoria Ward (alderman and three councillors) and the Scrabo and Glen aldermen were returned unopposed. Victoria Ward had no contest. Returned unopposed.
